lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters is visible across the lateral flank, arranged in at least four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, creating a series of grid-like anchor nodes along the mid-lateral and upper-lateral surfaces.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with highlight on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily near its base and posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, elongated appendage-like feature (likely a remora) is attached to the distal posterior margin of the pectoral fin; a separate dark, trailing feature is visible on the ventral silhouette near the posterior frame edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Concentrated, small-diameter high-luminance spotting is visible on the dorsal cephalic region, exhibiting a higher density and smaller radius than the patterns on the lateral flank.
